parts.name: Organic Regions
parts.description: Slowly flowing weighted regions with varied size and density. Supplies shader fragments and controls to a compatible painting renderer without an extra image pass.

parts.name: Region Hatching
parts.description: Region-specific curved, directional and perpendicular hatch patterns, with controlled irregularity and optional unhatched areas. Shader-field for compatible single-pass painting renderers.

parts.name: Animated Watercolor
parts.description: Slowly shifting blue-green washes and moving warm pools, with regional color contrast, pigment pooling and watercolor blooms. Shader-field for compatible painting renderers.
